queries_run: STMicroelectronics Apple largest customer second source OR in-house 2026

findings.claim: STM 20-F FY2025 揭露：最大客戶 Apple 占 2025 年營收 17.7%；近年部分客戶垂直整合，可能影響業務，失去關鍵客戶或重要 socket 會有不利影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: In recent years, some of our customers have vertically integrated their businesses. Such vertical integrations may impact our business.

findings.claim: 20-F 競爭章節列明競爭者包括自行開發 IC 產品與晶圓廠營運的客戶，部分競爭者同時是客戶或供應商。
findings.excerpt: Competitors include manufacturers of standard semiconductor devices, ASICs and fully customized ICs, including both chip and board-level products, as well as customers who develop their own IC products and foundry operations. Some of our competitors are also our customers or suppliers.

customer_second_source.note: 搜尋未找到 Apple 或其他最大客戶對 STM 導入第二供應商的 2026 報導；僅有 Apple 自研 RF/無線晶片的舊報導（供應商為 Broadcom、Skyworks、Qualcomm，非 STM 直接），未讀到原文故未列入。

clues.claim: Bloomberg 報導（經 Finanzaonline 轉述）：Apple 招募工程師自研無線/RF 晶片，Equita 分析師認為對 Apple 供應鏈含 STM 為負面，STM 股價當日跌近 3%。
clues.source: Finanzaonline: STMicroelectronics in caduta a Piazza Affari, Apple potrebbe sviluppare chip internamente
